{{Quote|That's the last of them, Bokar. These two are dead. Still no sign of Fel.|Yuln|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
'''Yuln''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], Yuln and another [[One Sith|Sith]], [[Bokar]], were dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to search for surviving enemy forces following a [[Operation: Thunderstroke|clash]] between Sith forces and an allied group of [[Imperial Knight]]s and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Three [[Time/Legends|days]] after the attack on Agamar, Yuln and Bokar were [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Imperial Knight [[Azlyn Rae]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rasi Tuum]], respectively.

==Biography==
{{Quote|And many Jedi and Imperial Knights died, Yuln, proving they are ''weaker'' than we Sith."''<br />"''Sith perished as well, Bokar."''<br />"''Weaklings! Better they be culled from the ranks of the One Sith!|Bokar and Yuln|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
[[File:Rae_kills_Yuln.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Yuln is impaled by Azlyn Rae's lightsaber on Agamar.]]
Yuln, a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], served in [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|Sith Order]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith–Imperial]] forces traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], intending to [[Operation: Thunderstroke|capture or kill]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]. After the battle, Yuln and fellow Sith [[Bokar]] were sent to Agamar's surface to search for Fel and [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] any of his surviving [[Imperial Knight]]s and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] allies.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

Three [[Time/Legends|days]] after the attack on Agamar, as the two Sith were searching for survivors of the battle, Yuln informed Bokar that all the remaining Jedi and Imperial Knights were dead. The two Sith began arguing over the strength of the Sith, Jedi, and Imperial Knights who perished during the battle. They were interrupted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rasi Tuum]], who slew Bokar, as Yuln was [[Shiak|impaled]] and killed by Imperial Knight [[Azlyn Rae]]'s [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Personality and traits==
Yuln's body was covered in [[Color/Legends|red]] and black [[Sith tattoo]]s, with three [[Piercing/Legends|piercings]] over a scar that extended from the corner of the Sith's mouth. Yuln had black [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. When Bokar interpreted the deaths of so many Jedi and Imperial Knights on Agamar to mean that the Sith were superior to both orders, Yuln pointed out that Sith had also died.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Equipment==
The Sith carried a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] and donned gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yuln was introduced by writer [[John Ostrander]] and penciller [[Jan Duursema]] in the [[Legacy (2006) 48|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Extremes|''Extremes'']] story arc, part of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The issue was released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 48" /> on [[May 26]], [[2010]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-989/Star-Wars-Legacy-48---Extremes-Part-1|text=Star Wars: Legacy #48 - Extremes (Part 1)}}</ref>
